title: Listening to Instructions and Questions
introduction: Practise listening to instructions and questions with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Listen to short instructions and questions about familiar things.
rules: Ask a partner to read aloud: Open your book. Point to the door. Close your book.
Follow each instruction before checking the text.
Try asking your partner to repeat an instruction if needed.

examples.question: Complete the instruction: Open your ___. (book or run)
